input: made ai resume builder project using react django and latex where user enters rough points and the system converts them into resume bullets and pdf is generated

output.title: AI-Powered Resume Builder
output.summary: A full-stack web application that transforms rough user inputs into polished resume bullets and generates downloadable PDFs.
bullets: Developed a full-stack web application utilizing React for a responsive user interface and Django for robust backend API management.
Integrated an LLM workflow to process informal, rough user inputs and dynamically generate polished, professional resume bullet points.
Implemented a LaTeX compilation pipeline to automatically format the AI-generated content and generate downloadable, high-quality PDF resumes.
